#### ***CDSE CUI Training Certificates***

  
***\* The [*CUI Mandatory Training Course*](https://www.cdse.edu/Training/eLearning/IF141/) is the official initial CUI training course and also meets the annual refresher training requirement.  **  
  
**Certificates:**   
  
When you finish the test at the end of the CDSE mandatory training course you have the opportunity to create and print a certificate.   
  
If you take the training through a learning management system, the system will record the completion and you have the option to print a certificate.  If you have any problems with getting a certificate, please talk to your training manager.   
  
You can take the training through the Security Awareness Hub where you do not need login credentials.  When you complete the CUI course or any other course on the hub, it provides you with a Certification Completion that can be printed or saved right after you pass the course.  However, the Security Awareness Hub does not have the ability to record or save your completion.*
